name: Piana degli Albanesi (Italy)
description: Red field with a thin yellow border, charged at the centre with a black double-headed eagle (the Albanian eagle) above a row of white embattlements along the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Piana degli Albanesi, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: row of embattlements along the bottom edge
